# Spiking_Mamba_Block

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A neuromorphic adaptation of the Mamba state-space model where recurrent state updates are computed using spiking activations and event-driven gating mechanisms. Enables efficient temporal sequence processing on neuromorphic hardware by combining selective state-space dynamics with sparse, event-based computation.
